newsitem.title: DENMARK: FORECAST - Danish March WPI seen up 1.2 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Danish March WPI seen up 1.2 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Danish wholesale prices are expected to have risen 1.2 percent in March 1997, compared with the same month a year earlier, a Reuter consensus survey of five analysts showed.
Forecasts ranged from a low of 1.0 percent to a high of 1.3 percent.
March wholesale price data is to be published by the National Statistics office at 0730 GMT on April 28.
In February, wholesale prices rose 1.4 percent year-on-year.
